title: Weighted gene co-expression network analysis combined with machine learning validation to identify key hub biomarkers in colorectal cancer.
authors: Guo, Chenchen; Xie, Bin; Liu, Quanguo
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过WGCNA和机器学习筛选结直肠癌hub基因，属于纯转录组表达分析，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is one of the most common malignancies worldwide; however, the potentially possible molecular biological mechanism of CRC is still not completely comprehended. This study aimed to confirm candidate key hub genes involved in the growth and development of CRC and their connection with immune infiltration as well as the related pathways. Gene expression data were selected from the GEO dataset. Hub genes for CRC were identified on the basis of differential expression analysis, weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), and LASSO regression. Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), Gene Ontology (GO), and Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) were applied to reveal possible functions of the differential genes. Single-sample GSEA (ssGSEA) was implemented to identify the relationship between immune cells infiltration and hub genes. Two hundred and sixty-two differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified. Three modules were acquired based on WGCNA, and the blue module presented the highest relevance with CRC. Ten hub genes (AQP8, B3GALT5, CDH3, CEMIP, CPM, FOXQ1, PLAC8, SCNN1B, SPINK5, and SST) were acquired with LASSO analysis as underlying biomarkers for CRC. Compared with normal tissues, CRC tissues presented significantly higher numbers of CD4 T cells, CD8 T cells, B cells, natural regulatory T (Treg) cells, and monocytes. The functional enrichment analyses demonstrated that hub genes were primarily enriched in metabolic process, inflammatory-related, and immune-related response. Ten hub genes were identified to be involved in the occurrence and development of CRC and may be deemed as novel biomarkers for clinical diagnosis and treatment.
abstract_zh: 结直肠癌（CRC）是全球最常见的恶性肿瘤之一；然而，CRC潜在可能的分子生物学机制尚未被完全理解。本研究旨在确认参与CRC生长和发育的候选关键枢纽基因及其与免疫浸润和相关通路的关联。基因表达数据选自GEO数据集。基于差异表达分析、加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）和LASSO回归，鉴定了CRC的枢纽基因。应用《京都基因与基因组百科全书》（KEGG）、基因本体论（GO）和基因集富集分析（GSEA）来揭示差异基因的可能功能。采用单样本GSEA（ssGSEA）来识别免疫细胞浸润与枢纽基因之间的关系。共鉴定出262个差异表达基因（DEGs）。基于WGCNA获得了三个模块，其中蓝色模块与CRC的相关性最高。通过LASSO分析获得了十个枢纽基因（AQP8、B3GALT5、CDH3、CEMIP、CPM、FOXQ1、PLAC8、SCNN1B、SPINK5和SST），作为CRC的潜在生物标志物。与正常组织相比，CRC组织中CD4 T细胞、CD8 T细胞、B细胞、自然调节性T（Treg）细胞和单核细胞的数量显著更高。功能富集分析表明，枢纽基因主要富集于代谢过程、炎症相关和免疫相关反应中。鉴定出十个枢纽基因参与CRC的发生和发展，可能被视为临床诊断和治疗的新型生物标志物。
